Welcome to your first night shift, Operator.

YOUR TASKS are listed in the Work Queue window (top right) and on the taskbar. Do them in order. Each task has a hint under it.

- Double-click an icon or a file to open it.
- Drag a window by its title bar to move it.
- Drag a file onto a folder to move it there.
- Drag a file onto the Disposal bin to shred it.
- Right-click anything to see what you can do.

Some programs need clearance you do not have. Stick to your tasks.

NEXUS OS 4.1 -- QUICK HELP

YOUR SHIFT: your tasks are in the Work Queue (top right, or the Task button on the taskbar). Do them in order; the hint under each task says how.

OPEN: Double-click an icon or file to open it.
MOVE A WINDOW: Drag it by its title bar.
MOVE FILES: Open File Manager (Workstation), then drag a file onto a folder in the left pane.
SHRED: Drag a file onto the Disposal bin, then click Yes.
WORK ORDERS: Look the owner up in Personnel, then Approve or Reject.
OPTIONS: Right-click an item to see what you can do with it.
LOCKED: Some programs and folders need clearance. You will be told if that changes.

NEXUS OS records all activity for quality purposes.

Welcome to your first night shift, Operator.

YOUR TASKS are listed in the Work Queue window (top right) and on the taskbar. Do them in order. Each task has a hint under it.

- Press A twice on an icon or a file to open it (or tap it twice).
- Hold R2 on a window's title bar and move to drag it.
- Hold R2 on a file and move it onto a folder to move it there.
- Drop a file on the Disposal bin to shred it.
- Press L2 on anything to see what you can do.
- B or the Menu button pauses the shift.

Some programs need clearance you do not have. Stick to your tasks.

NEXUS OS 4.1 -- QUICK HELP

YOUR SHIFT: your tasks are in the Work Queue (top right, or the Task button on the taskbar). Do them in order; the hint under each task says how.

OPEN: Press A twice on an icon or file (or tap it twice).
MOVE A WINDOW: Hold R2 on its title bar and move.
MOVE FILES: Open File Manager (Workstation), then hold R2 on a file and drop it on a folder in the left pane.
SHRED: Drop a file on the Disposal bin, then choose Yes.
WORK ORDERS: Look the owner up in Personnel, then Approve or Reject.
OPTIONS: Press L2 on an item to see what you can do with it.
TYPING: the on-screen keyboard opens by itself when you can type.
LOCKED: Some programs and folders need clearance. You will be told if that changes.

NEXUS OS records all activity for quality purposes.
